changed.summary: On regenerating, the crew found the paper's z<6 main-sequence 'elevation' is largely an emission-line SELECTION artifact (~40-60% at z<6; pure selection not excluded below z~6), so the z<6 SFR-evolution / 'rapid early enrichment' claim was WITHDRAWN, not softened. Only the z>6 residual survives; the MZR deficit defers to the flagship z~9-10 study (#1). Per the fold decision it is not shipped as a standalone result: the selection forward-model is credited to the TNG confrontation (#6). The reframed PDF withdraws the claim honestly. Descriptive - not validated.
